name: Jet Jammer - ATK
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. It can also affect the ATK of enemy STs.

61244.name: Flying Device I · ATK
61244.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
In combat, the enemy's DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
